parsed.rationale: Both participating records live under test file paths — `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package `Metadata`) and `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package `app:iOS`) — making them test fixtures by location even though the `is_test` flag is not set to true. The type `MockDiscogsEntityResolver` is a mock helper (its name carries the `Mock` prefix) used independently by two distinct test suites testing different concerns (`DiscogsMarkupParser` vs `DiscogsFormatter`). Consolidating these into a shared target would couple two separate test packages through a shared mock dependency, which is undesirable and fragile. The duplication is intentional: each test file owns its own lightweight mock definition scoped to its own test context.
